description: Export the project with one of its export_presets.cfg presets (Godot's `--export-release`, headless, fixed argument list, no shell). The output always goes under res://build/ — pass `path` to choose the name, or omit it for res://build/<preset>/ (index.html for Web). Returns the files written with their sizes, plus the tail of Godot's log. Fails with TEMPLATES_MISSING when Godot has no export templates installed. `dry_run` shows the command and the target without exporting.

dry_run.description: Validate the preset and the path, show the command, export nothing.

path.description: Output under res://build/... — a folder or .html for Web, a file for the other platforms.

preset.description: Preset name from export_presets.cfg (project_info can list them).

name: project_export
title: Export the project
